text: Computer vision is a fascinating field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a bicycle. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects within a single image. These technologies have many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognize traffic signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and smartphone face unlock features. As technology improves, computers will become even better at seeing and understanding the world around them.
